'''Taptail''' is a [[Rock]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves into [[Rattlecoil]] at 6 bronze stars.

==Overview==
Current Description: "Tapping the head with a tail mallet is a sure way to accumulate karma and earn forgiveness. Or so Taptail firmly believes, after stealing another Tatari's lunch at least."

Taptail is a purple rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
A small, coiled snake with a round, bronze bell for a head. It has black eyes with yellow-white pupils, and its body is white and brown striped. It holds a brown mallet with its tail, which it taps itself in the head with. Its snake-like tongue will sometimes extend from the slot of the bell which resembles its mouth.

Taptail's [[Tatari#Glitter Tataris|Glitter]] form changes its brown stripes to dark green, and its tongue changes from red to blue.

== Evolution Trial ==
Taptail's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 6 bronze stars/19 copies. To evolve it into [[Rattlecoil]] you need to complete the following task:

* Kill 300 [[Zobos]] while clearing [[Battle|stages]].

== Trivia ==
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "People think that Taptail is a living good-luck charm. They always boop its head. Not a good idea."
* Prior to the update on 5/12/2026, its bio description said: "Taptails strike their heads with the tail-mounted mallets regularly each day, which creates a noise that unnerves Zobos."
